verdict.rationale: Incremental rollout is a fair question for a serverless deployment platform, but the evidence pack never documents gradual or percentage-based deployments, traffic splitting, or canary releases for Workers. The only related item covers rolling back to a previous version (cloudflare-docs-23). Rollback is a different capability, so it earns no credit toward incremental rollout.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can roll out new deployments incrementally to reduce blast radius
